summary:
Newly qualified CA with experience in statutory audits, risk assessment, financial reporting, and tax compliance across Real Estate, IT,
Trading, Manufacturing, Banking, and Insurance industries. Proactive, detail-oriented professional with strong analytical and stakeholder
management skills. Adept at leading audit teams, optimizing audit processes, and delivering high-quality work within strict timelines.

responsibilities: Led statutory audits for approximately six clients, including major Real Estate (₹100 Cr+), Hospitality, Trading, and IT companies.
Performed risk assessments, including walkthroughs and control testing.
Performed substantive testing of various accounts, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, revenue, payroll, cash, and bank.
Enhanced audit efficiency by optimizing procedures and improving communication.
Conducted internal audits, identified control gaps, and proposed process enhancements.
Assessed internal controls for P2P, O2C, payroll, and fixed asset cycles.
Developed, implemented, and administered accounting and auditing systems in 5+ organizations.
Managed a team of 4 members, allocating tasks, reviewing work papers, and ensuring timely completion of statutory audit deliverables with high-quality documentation as per SA standards
Performed statutory audits across Trading, Manufacturing, Insurance, Banking, Cooperative Societies, and IT.
Prepared ITRs, TDS returns, Tax Audit Reports, and managed reconciliations.
Assisted in finalizing Financial Statements, Audit Reports, CARO, and Tax/MAT calculations.
Handled routine entries of financial transactions related to payroll sheets and departmental expenses
